title: FTC Cooling-Off Rule - three-day cancellation
facts: The FTC Cooling-Off Rule gives consumers three business days to cancel certain sales of $25 or more made at the consumer's home or $130 or more made at certain temporary locations.
The rule has exclusions and does not create a three-day cancellation right for ordinary purchases made at a seller's permanent place of business or for every online or automobile transaction.
Covered sellers must provide required cancellation disclosures and forms.
